title: What the dated ZPC (Posture Control) release upgrade summary notes for 2022 and 2023 say

subjects.title: What the dated ZPC (Posture Control) release upgrade summary notes for 2022 and 2023 say
subjects.lead: The December 08, 2022 note says agentless vulnerability scanning of AWS Windows workloads is supported, for Windows Server 2016, 2019 and 2022.
